about.title: About Me
about.p1: My name is Vítor Silva, and I am a full-stack developer with one year of experience in the field. I have skills in
about.spanTecs: React, NextJS, ContextAPI, Redux, JavaScript, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MySQL, REST API, and NodeJS.
about.p2: I am also a musician with eleven years of experience, which has helped me develop my soft skills, such as teamwork, discipline, persistence, creativity, learning, resilience, active listening, memory, empathy, aesthetic discernment, and more.

acs.title: ACS - Institutional Website
acs.description: An institutional website created voluntarily for the Associação Cultural Surubinense to promote the culture and history of Surubim-PE and its projects.

softPet.title: SoftPet - PetShop Management System
softPet.description: A pet shop management system developed from a Figma design to simplify pet shop management, with functionalities for customer registration, animals, services, and reports.

Catalogo.title: Product Catalog
Catalogo.description: A product catalog designed to facilitate the visualization of products and their details, allowing customers to add items to the cart and place orders directly via WhatsApp.

cadastroLoginFusion.title: User Registration - Fusion
cadastroLoginFusion.description: A user registration and login system developed as a challenge in the Fusion Frontend project, aiming to help beginner developers gain team experience voluntarily.

galeriaFusion.title: Fusion Gallery
galeriaFusion.description: An image gallery developed as a challenge in the Fusion Frontend project, aiming to help beginner developers gain team experience voluntarily.

calcInvest.title: Investment Calculator
calcInvest.description: An investment calculator designed to help choose the best investment for your money, based on the initial amount, monthly contribution, investment duration, and profitability.
